drafts.subject: Invoice LIS-0003321 (PO 4500012149) already received - no action needed
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your invoice LIS-0003321 dated 20 August 2026 for $874.50 (including GST), issued against our purchase order 4500012149.

Our records show this invoice has already been received and entered into our system (reference 5105000257, for the same amount of $874.50). To avoid paying it twice, we will not process the second copy. The invoice is scheduled for payment on 19 September 2026, and your remittance will quote invoice number LIS-0003321.

No action is needed from you. If you could please avoid resending this invoice, we would appreciate it.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
